The tsc run, the vitest run (25 files, 431 tests), and the bundle comparison pass. Three Nit findings stay nonblocking: F2 and F4 (declined by Green) and a new optional F5.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: extensions/measure-status/src/board.ts:276 reads only the first line of the task text for rule a0, because src/parse.ts:150 stores only the first line. A verification row with the words 'deferred' or 'no visible change' only on a wrapped continuation line gives Waits for Daniel: look through rule R3a (board.ts:293), when the row is the current task and the age is 14 days or less. Acceptance criterion 5 fails for that shape. FR-11 a0 says 'text', so the spec is ambiguous. A fresh read-only scan of the eight repos at ac1bf90 finds no such row: 60 open rows carry the words on the first line, 204 carry none, 0 carry them only on a continuation line. Rationale: the input class is the same class as the lending-desk-bench tag bug, and the PM check of the first real Waits for Daniel card covers a fault of this shape. | Disposition: DECLINE (Green: defer). Carried forward, nonblocking.

F4 [Nit] phase-acceptance: measure/tracks/board_focus_reasons_20261121/plan.md:21 and plan.md:27 write counts (65 failing tests, 23 suites, 351 tests, 242 cards, and since ac1bf90 the word Three for live rows). skills/measure-orchestrator/SKILL.md:124 says to write no test count or check count in plan.md and to cite the log file. The counts are true (red-p2.log, ux-browser-e410fd1.json, ux-p2/all-open-cards.json), so no A5 mismatch exists. Rationale: a pinned count drifts with the next change and starts a record-fix round. | Disposition: DECLINE (Green: accept). Carried forward, nonblocking.

F5 [Nit] phase-acceptance: extensions/measure-status/README.md:96-97 and :100 give the verification, gate, and `[b]` non-gate rules without the 'first not-done task' scope of FR-11 a0, a, and c. Read alone, 'A `[b]` task with a non-gate owner gives Waits for PM' also fits a `[b]` task behind an open `[ ]` task, where the card shows Next in line. A read-only scan of 239 open tracks finds 3 tracks with that shape and 15 tracks with a deferred verification row that is not the first not-done task. Rationale: lines 96-97 had the same omission before the F1 fix, the F1 fix states the three required cases with the exact lines, and each card names its true cause in the reason line. The finding is optional and nonblocking, and a README change after this acceptance moves HEAD and needs a new acceptance run.
